items: Mystery simply means something that baffles understanding and cannot be explained.
It takes its root from the Latin word ‘mysterium’ and from the ancient Greek word ‘musterion,’ meaning a secret or secret rite.
Iniquity from its root word ‘anomia’ (in Greek) means illegality, i.e. violation of law or wickedness: transgression of the law, unrighteousness or lawlessness.
Therefore, the mystery of iniquity is a system of lawlessness of which believers are warned and should watch out for.
